findings.description: The new `Amended by` link points to `0127-the-complexity-stage-judges-a-new-file-on-its.md`, which does not exist at this head, so the link is dead until ADR 0127 lands.
findings.body:
The new `Amended by` line links to `0127-the-complexity-stage-judges-a-new-file-on-its.md`, but that file is not in this branch. It is also not on `main`, even after the merge of `main` in 7af71b9.

- Globbing `docs/adr/012*` at head returns 0120, 0121, 0123, 0124, 0125, 0128 and 0129. There is no 0127.
- `docs/adr/README.md` goes straight from 0125 to 0128.
- The ADR exists only in commits `deeafd5`, `2eb4b59` and `6ea6bf4`. None of them is in HEAD's history (`git rev-list --count HEAD..6ea6bf4` = 3). They are presumably the branch of PR #216.

The link itself is right. The filename matches the one in those commits, and 0127's header there reads `- Amends: [0021](...)`, so "amended by" describes the relationship correctly. The problem is merge order: if this PR merges before ADR 0127 reaches `main`, ADR 0021 links to a file that does not exist. Merge the PR that adds 0127 first, or fold this line into that PR.

<https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/7af71b96f30d90e4facbbfe938c8e5eb452dc888/docs/adr/0021-debt-delta-three-soft-stages-with-a-merge.md#L4-L4>
